$generated_by: an independent generator (ml-dsa 0.1.1 deterministic signing, sha3 0.10, hmac 0.12); every value here is recomputable from the seeds
cross_role_controls: a binding signature by A over the binding body WITHOUT the domain prefix must not verify as a binding
A's binding signature must not verify as a well-known or challenge signature over the same bytes
the server challenge signature for cid X must not verify for cid X+1, another domain, or another nonce

domains.separator: every signed or hashed message is domain ‖ 0x00 ‖ body; the three HMAC sub-key labels are the whole HMAC message, with no separator
